messages.subject: morphol.disparity() issue
parts:
Hello, 

I'm completely new to the geomorph package (and a beginner in R). I am trying to determine morphological disparity between the Plethodon groups according to site: morphol.disparity(pleth.gpa$coords, groups= ~ plethodon$site, iter = 99) just to practice with this function, but I keep getting an error message which reads: Error in levels(gps) : object 'gps' not found. Any help would be greatly appreciated !

- Ricardo Ely

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] morphol.disparity() issue
parts:
Ricardo,

The first argument needs to be a formula or procD.lm object (from a previous analysis) so that the function knows from where to obtain residuals.  

Cheers!
Mike
